claim: Try it with sample data opens a complete comparison in an isolated demo that can be reset or left without changing real data.
where: Home first screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: Fresh browser state; click the home sample action once; assert result, sample label, reset, start-real, and an untouched real-data sentinel.

claim: The tool compares planned and exported GPX routes and flags sections beyond the chosen distance.
sandbox: Demo pair; assert a measured separation above 50 metres and one visible review zone.

claim: The tool loads GPX tracks and routes through a file chooser or drag and drop.
where: Upload controls, How it works, README
sandbox: Demo entry; replace the sample with a track through the file input and a route through a drop event, then compare them.

claim: Distance sampling avoids false changes from point density or reversed route direction.
sandbox: Demo entry; compare a dense line with the same sparse reversed line and assert 100 percent fidelity with no zones.

claim: Two-way measurement catches exported detours, shortcuts, and added loops.
sandbox: Demo entry; run detour, shortcut, and added-loop pairs and assert every pair produces a review zone.

claim: A comparison reports fidelity, largest separation, distance change, and review-zone count.
sandbox: Complete demo result; assert four populated metric outcomes with units and a zone count.

claim: The aligned route trace can focus a review zone without map tiles or route services.
sandbox: Demo result with request capture; assert both SVG lines, a changed view box after focus, reset, and first-party-only requests.

claim: The populated ride-leader checklist can be printed.
sandbox: Demo result; assert four checklist items and observe the browser print call after using Print checklist.

claim: The completed comparison summary can be copied.
sandbox: Demo result with clipboard permission; copy and assert the clipboard contains the measured zone, threshold, and scope warning.

claim: The comparison works offline after the first visit.
where: Home first screen, network state, README
sandbox: Dedicated fresh phone context; load demo, wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and assert the completed result.

claim: GPX files and comparison results stay in browser memory and are not uploaded.
sandbox: Demo entry; upload named private fixtures while recording requests and storage, then assert no non-GET request or browser-storage write.

claim: Refreshing or closing the real comparison clears route and checklist state.
sandbox: Enter through demo, start for real, complete a named comparison, reload, and assert the files and result are gone.

claim: The app uses no accounts, analytics, ads, cookies, tracking pixels, third-party scripts, or map tiles.
sandbox: Fresh context and full demo flow; capture every request and cookie, asserting first-party-only traffic and no cookies.

claim: The route comparison is free to use.
sandbox: Fresh demo; complete, copy, and print a comparison without credentials, checkout navigation, or outside requests.

claim: GPX files up to and including 15 MB are accepted.
sandbox: Demo entry; upload valid GPX at exactly 15 MiB and then at 15 MiB plus one byte, asserting acceptance and rejection.

claim: The separation threshold accepts 10 to 500 metres inclusive.
sandbox: Demo pair; reject 9 and 501, then complete comparisons at 10 and 500 metres.

claim: The checked-in 30-pair corpus detects at least 90 percent of known material changes and renders each result within 15 seconds.
sandbox: Demo entry; load all 30 planned/exported GPX pairs through the product, measure recall and each result time, and check three clear controls.

claim: The product provides a standalone web-app manifest with 192 px, 512 px, and maskable icons.
sandbox: Demo page; retrieve its linked manifest and every declared icon, then assert standalone display and required icon purposes.
